timed_events.message: The hour grows late. Guests are beginning to leave.
Dawn approaches. The servants will scatter. I must finish this now.

triggered_events.message: Ezra admits he doesn't know where the wine came from. The servants know something.
The servants' testimonies match. They filled the jars with water, and drew out wine.
120 gallons minimum. No merchant could smuggle that volume into a wedding unnoticed.
Every rational explanation eliminated. The wine came from nowhere — or from somewhere beyond your understanding.
Mary places a hand on your arm. 'Go speak to his followers. They are in the eastern corner.'
The disciples' account matches the servants' testimony perfectly. Independent witnesses. The same story.
Water became wine. The mystery is solved — not with an answer, but with wonder.
